notablePrerequisites: Illusionist's Bracers attached to Cogwork Assembler.
description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, targeting Composite Golem.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Cogwork Assembler's ability, targeting Composite Golem.
Resolve both Cogwork Assembler abilities, creating two token copies of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate both Composite Golem tokens by sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
